page_title: ACM 1-2 LAZ | AC Milan v Lazio 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Ivan Provedel punches the ball away.
90+8' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Pedro (Lazio) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Mike Maignan no chance!
90+7' Pedro (Lazio) is going to take the penalty!
90+6' It’s a PENALTY to Lazio after the VAR review!

90+5' There's a break in play and referee Gianluca Manganiello must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lazio using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+3' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.
90+3' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+2' Matias Vecino (Lazio) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+1' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) misses a promising chance to score from the free kick, but Mike Maignan makes a decent save.
90+1' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) brings an opponent down and Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game. It's a free kick to Lazio in a dangerous position.
90+1' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The shots on goal statistics – 4:6.
89' Mario Gila (Lazio) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
88' The referee signals a substitution. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) is brought on as a substitute for Boulaye Dia.
87' The foul by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
86' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Mike Maignan makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
86' Lazio players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.

84' 1 - 1 Rafael Leao displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it in off the crossbar – 1:1.
84' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Luka Jovic (AC Milan) coming on for Matteo Gabbia.
83' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Boulaye Dia (Lazio) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
82' Joao Felix (AC Milan) is penalised for a foul. Gianluca Manganiello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
80' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
79' Here is a change. Mattia Zaccagni is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Pedro (Lazio).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Gigot trots off the pitch and is replaced by Patric (Lazio).
78' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
77' Lazio couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Mike Maignan (AC Milan) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
76' Booking. Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) receives a caution from the referee.
75' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
73' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
73' Lazio are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.
71' What a miskick by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
70' Sergio Conceicao has decided to substitute Christian Pulisic and he is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Youssouf Fofana will be replaced by Malick Thiaw (AC Milan).
69' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Kyle Walker (AC Milan). Gianluca Manganiello saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
69' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) makes an ugly tackle on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!
66' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Ivan Provedel is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
65' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece.
64' What a chance that is! Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post.
63' Half-chance! Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Ivan Provedel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
63' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
62' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
60' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
59' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Substitution. Loum Tchaouna will be replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
58' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' Great solo effort from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.
53' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
52' That's unlucky! Joao Felix (AC Milan) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
50' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
50' Samuel Gigot (Lazio) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by Mike Maignan.
49' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
48' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
48' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
48' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
47' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Sergio Conceicao has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Kyle Walker comes on the pitch for Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Adam Marusic (Lazio) comes off for Manuel Lazzari.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+3' A sweet pass finds Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Ivan Provedel is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
45+2' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) hits a screaming first-time shot from the edge of the box from a clearance, but it flies a whisker wide of the left post.
45+1' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Adam Marusic (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
41' Joao Felix (AC Milan) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post.
39' A pass by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
38' A long pass, executed by Nuno Tavares (Lazio), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
37' The substitution has been made. Joao Felix (AC Milan) has replaced Yunus Musah.
36' Half-chance! Yunus Musah (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Ivan Provedel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
34' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
33' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
30' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' 0 - 1 Goal! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
28' Adam Marusic (Lazio) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Mike Maignan.
26' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
26' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
24' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes.
23' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mike Maignan.
23' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
20' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!

19' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
17' Referee Gianluca Manganiello sees the trip by Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
14' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post.
11' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
10' 51:49 – the ratio of ball possession.
8' AC Milan are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
7' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner with a short pass.

7' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The referee blows his whistle, Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
6' This shall not pass! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
4' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Boulaye Dia (Lazio), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
4' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

3' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom right corner as Mike Maignan produces a good save.
1' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
AC Milan will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
